first.rationale: Current situation shows simultaneous declines in both activation (6% QoQ) and onboarding completion (4% QoQ). Memory 31 and 86 both demonstrate that simplification and shortening of onboarding directly improved early-stage metrics. While competitor pricing pressure exists, chasing promotional pricing now risks margin erosion on accounts we could have converted through better onboarding experience. Verifying these two memories will confirm whether recent onboarding friction has emerged that can be remedied. Simplify_onboarding directly addresses the measurable drops in completion and activation, and builds on durable evidence. This preserves optionality on referral incentives (memory 57) and pricing (memory 73) for future weeks. Enterprise sales assist (memory 44) is orthogonal to the SMB activation crisis. One standard experiment on onboarding simplification can generate quick learnings and has lowest downside risk to long-term unit economics.
